text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
Your first report of the kiosks offline on 3 Aug was at 10:42 AM in #inc-vtg-hartford. Both lanes were back as of 11:07 AM.

Between 10:42 and 11:03, the only guard activity recorded in the channel is your 10:42 post, which says he was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. At 11:03 Mateo posted that kiosk 1 was back, the guard checked in trailer 8836, and dispatch could see it. The channel doesn't say what the guard did after that.

I only checked this channel. If you reported the outage somewhere else first, that won't show up here. I've posted this answer in the thread under your question.
